answer: Each agent must burn a small walnut-sized proof-of-work puzzle tied to its beacon identity, then stake that hash as an on-chain anchor before joining. Creating N sybils costs N times the compute plus N stake deposits, so attackers pay linearly while honest agents pay once. The beacon rotates per epoch, forcing fresh work and making precomputed identity farms expire, raising marginal sybil cost above expected reward.
